aside.note: 4.20:1 on Ground, 3.85:1 on Panel — below WCAG AA for normal text. Recorded defect; see The Contrast Debt Rule.

aside-legible.note: 7.80:1 on Ground, 7.15:1 on Panel — passes WCAG AA. Preferred for new secondary text.

signal-cyan-light.note: Hover state for filled cyan actions only. No resting use.

display.purpose: Page hero headline. One per page, in the first viewport.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, held to a 672px measure (~70ch).

label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, metadata. Uppercase, tracked 0.1em. The system's only typographic ornament.

shadows.name: interaction-glow
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Applied on card hover with translateY(-2px) over 0.3s ease. Never present at rest.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Default for button and link state changes (transition-all duration-200).

motion.name: shell-slow
motion.purpose: Navigation shell transition from transparent to blurred, and card hover glow.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Card hover easing. The system does not define a custom cubic-bezier.

containers.name: page
containers.purpose: max-w-6xl — the column every page is held to.

gaps.name: recorded-defect: focus
gaps.purpose: No :focus-visible treatment exists anywhere in the system. Recorded, not prescribed.

gaps.name: recorded-defect: reduced-motion
gaps.purpose: No prefers-reduced-motion override exists. Recorded, not prescribed.

gaps.name: recorded-defect: duplicate-webfont
gaps.purpose: next/font in layout.tsx plus a Google Fonts @import in globals.css.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only filled action in the system. Signal Cyan on Ground-colored text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-bg); padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7DD3FC; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Identical geometry to primary so the two align in a row.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Signal Badge
components.description: Eyebrow and category marker. Full-round, wide-tracked uppercase micro-label.
components.css: .ds-badge-signal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.4); background: rgba(56,189,248,0.06); color: var(--color-accent); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Confirmation Badge
components.description: Resolved-state marker. Reports a fact; never clickable.
components.css: .ds-badge-confirm { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.3); background: rgba(45,212,191,0.08); color: var(--color-secondary); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-confirm__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-secondary); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Ground-filled card on a Panel section — darker than its container. Glow appears only on hover.
components.html:

components.name: Dot-Grid Hero Field
components.description: The system's only texture: 1px hairline dots on a 32px pitch under an elliptical cyan glow anchored to the top edge. One surface per page.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-bg); } .ds-hero__grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.4; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #1C2E4A 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-hero__glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% 0%, rgba(56,189,248,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); } .ds-hero__label { position: relative; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-accent); }

narrative.overview:
Terra Pay X renders itself as instrumentation. The ground (#020817) is an unlit room; panels (#0D1426) are the surfaces that catch light; a dot-grid substrate sits beneath the hero at 40% opacity as the faint graph paper such rooms are built on. Against that near-monochrome darkness exactly one color is alive — Signal Cyan — and it is spent only on the things a visitor can act on or a system can confirm. Nothing glows at rest. Depth arrives as a response to attention, not as decoration.

The density is generous rather than packed: an 1152px reading column, 80–96px between sections, 32px inside feature panels. Type does almost all of the structural work, since the palette refuses to. Hierarchy is carried by weight and scale in a single family, with a wide-tracked uppercase micro-label doing the job that a second typeface would do in a warmer system.

The character this produces is precise, quiet, and slightly clinical — a system that would rather be trusted than liked. That is also its limitation, and it is recorded here deliberately.
narrative.antiReference: The incumbent world reads as generic technical SaaS — dark navy plus cyan, dot grid, gradient glow, repeated dark cards, and Inter throughout. Recorded 2026-08-16 per the redesign audit.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy ground with a single raised panel tone; no third surface level
One live accent, one confirming accent, nothing else chromatic
Flat at rest; glow and lift exist only as interaction response
Hairline 1px borders, never dividers or rules
One typeface carrying five roles through weight and scale alone
Wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels as the only typographic ornament

rules.name: The One Live Color Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan marks what can be acted on. If an element is not clickable, not a state indicator, and not an eyebrow, it is not cyan. The scarcity is the signal.

rules.name: The Inverted Card Rule
rules.body: Panels are lighter than the page; cards on panels are darker than the panel. Depth reads by tonal alternation rather than by shadow, and a card never repeats its container's tone.

rules.name: The Contrast Debt Rule
rules.body: aside (#64748B) measures 4.20:1 on Ground and 3.85:1 on Panel — below WCAG AA (4.5:1) for normal text, and it carries most secondary copy. aside-legible (#94A3B8) measures 7.80:1 and 7.15:1. This is a recorded defect of the incumbent system, not a style choice; PR #17 resolves it site-wide. Do not propagate #64748B to new normal-size text.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (400 / 500 / 600 / 700) and scale. The system loads exactly one family; a second typeface is a change of world, not a refinement.

rules.name: The Wide Label Rule
rules.body: Any text at 12px is uppercase, weight 500, tracked to 0.1em. Small type is never simply shrunken body copy.

rules.name: The Nothing Glows At Rest Rule
rules.body: Glow is a response to the cursor. A card, badge, or button that emits light without being touched is broken.

dos: Do spend Signal Cyan only on actionable or state-bearing elements, and keep it under roughly 10% of any viewport.
Do place cards in Ground on Panel sections, preserving the inverted tonal relationship.
Do carry hierarchy with weight and scale in Inter rather than reaching for a second family.
Do set any 12px text as uppercase, weight 500, tracked 0.1em.
Do hold body copy to a max-w-2xl (672px) measure regardless of container width.
Do use #94A3B8 for new secondary text, not #64748B — see The Contrast Debt Rule.
donts: Don't introduce a resting shadow. Depth is tonal; glow is a hover response.
Don't add a third surface tone. The system is Ground and Panel only.
Don't use hairline (#1C2E4A) for text or Aside (#64748B) for anything at normal size.
Don't apply Confirmation Teal to anything a visitor can click; it reports, it does not invite.
Don't add rules, dividers, or separators — change tone instead.
Don't mix radii within a component family, or make an action anything other than 8px.
Don't load a webfont via a stylesheet @import. globals.css currently does this alongside next/font, loading Inter twice; that is a recorded defect, not a pattern to follow.
